author: Deeba Ahmed
description: Researchers at CyberProof have identified a new fake captcha campaign linked to the ClickFix operation. This stealthy infostealer targets over 25 browsers, cryptocurrency wallets like MetaMask, and gaming accounts by tricking users into executing malicious PowerShell commands.
title: New ClickFix Attack Targets Crypto Wallets and 25+ Browsers with Infostealer
